result.markdown:
For a small company in the UK, I'd shortlist **Breathe HR, CharlieHR, Employment Hero and BrightHR**\.

My recommendation would be **CharlieHR for simplicity and value**, or **Breathe HR if you want a straightforward HR system that covers the essentials without unnecessary complexity**\.

The best choice depends on how many employees you have and whether you want payroll included.

## Best HR software for a small UK business

![HR Software for UK SMEs – Trusted by 17,000+ organisations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ROJAyOfUjHKEuFBNF1pHBPQHM0PLuIvCK0q8KQmZrpoEEyCHgmWjxWwAG_Ie8huEC0fFM24TmHCcpJtbR20JLvAHxGrWA4a6X3g_walj1XXFjcLPUM-k569UTN3Z62cwoEkeqnSg04nvlm5wphVNQ53Z9B30NqsDUYyfVczvoF43_i0QLqIID3NrWQR4SDCe?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Breathe HR**

(Best overall for small UK businesses)

From approximately £24/month for up to 10 employees

- Holiday and sickness management
- Employee records and documents
- Onboarding and performance reviews
- Employee self-service

Best for businesses wanting straightforward HR administration.

[Breathe HR website](https://www.breathehr.com/)

---

![Charlie Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/noUj6MXVV_rGiJLKtx7Sco_uFMazap-Xj1f5ZnbuWxRGBtoatMU6LXITBFxA8JUNPcWFD9T5pr_JiMeu656E7ai9bkUmdzZ5rOMZPBS9cgUZr_b99qJ7RflQxghLNMkwNZfoMUQ-02gNA9PIKaI2sy72PQwjqiP-vw0XxBZrHM6gFjfEXb1dklqCyzGWic1V?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. CharlieHR**

(Best for startups)

Entry pricing approximately £21/month for 1–4 employees

- Simple employee management
- Holiday tracking
- Automated onboarding
- HR advice and employee engagement features

Best for companies without a dedicated HR manager.

[CharlieHR website](https://www.charliehr.com/)

---

![2025 Employment Hero Annual Jobs Report Reveals a Workforce Under Pressure, On the Move, and Rewriting the Rules](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c72cfBM-wnkCY2sXvC-N2bdeXlozX_a6cLpeiRcNWIdO5skRSiJsO0H69D4TjL37larxeB9RHeRje9o33vXlesf4SGbT2cKN9yyK2lD71zg8gVLQUlVbvzPmQ7XZL_7bga6vNjcRIhuVAHDdb80aC6efbG65m_LmQQnOM37zl4ReRd-YURSotCy3M4QrvYQn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

- HR and payroll functionality
- Employee onboarding
- Employment documentation
- Workforce management

Best if you want to bring more of your people administration into one system.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightHR Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gC8IBBAPqsI2SVAsk3R4LrjZoZ-5bxi7-EcbEOB3KcHp8PDQa9qOw6ACIrb9VLYyhu5FvjAufdNhybguWPQ0Cv6UR_YRx4cxN2icpeqA44dqytZ2-60t-718dPbQhnh3gVgNGJqWtkwGZo6NQVxbB9SkuMVSsHOvLvkIBm5LE-4JdPACOxhQJgCF8aJsIlF8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. BrightHR**

(Best for HR support and compliance)

- Employment law resources
- HR document templates
- Holiday and absence tracking
- HR advice services

Particularly useful if you don't have an in-house HR specialist.

[BrightHR website](https://www.brighthr.com/)

---

![Sage HR – Medium](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IOxRfPPwqd3nboANipIHs5CbmjERnHn1phuBsjJ0Vz_exMcBIqWByS55YcBtjcyPrnXRKbAsPfbS1drRpEvk0_DCloaGSG6FIwMcVcWXij0nLQ8RQNZGBHRt1EGFJ-VcXlRTOVinX8bp-gxkMU13Fl7NwZf-4dzO1AcW1lhs1ScTBu6QW8z6-KeIL6IwDe_m?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Sage HR**

(Best for Sage users)

- Employee records
- Leave management
- Timesheets
- Performance management

Worth considering if your business already uses Sage accounting or payroll.

[Sage HR website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/products/sage-hr/)

## My recommendation

For a typical small UK company, I'd start by comparing Breathe HR and CharlieHR.

One important distinction: HR software doesn't necessarily include payroll. Check whether you need HMRC PAYE/RTI submissions and pension auto-enrolment as part of the package.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
